image_description: A studio product shot of a heavy-duty, multi-furrow reversible agricultural plow mounted on an orange and yellow frame. The implement features six large, black, twisted moldboard shares arranged in two vertical tiers (three top, three bottom). A hydraulic cylinder is visible in the center for flipping the plow. The background is plain white.
